summary: Restored the explicit knowledge use for the configuration-history account: its negative result rests on the leader gate that configurationChangeChIfStable enforces, so the Behaviour recording that gate is now listed as the entry the account relies on, by revision and assertion, alongside the source trace. The account itself, its counterevidence and its limitations are unchanged. I also read the LogCache helper while looking for an independent lead and found nothing to register — GetLog guards its ring slot with an index equality check, StoreLogs caches only after the backend accepts the write, and DeleteRange invalidates the whole cache before delegating, so the wrapper cannot return entries the store no longer holds. No execution was requested, and the other four questions are unchanged. Remaining run time is about half an hour; if any of it is useful it would go to an independent lead rather than further repetition, since every question now carries an account with receipts and the one open gap was resolved with a reproduced witness.
